// CASE abort_cleanup_nested_loop expect=fire
Future<void> a1(List<List<int>> batches) async {
  for (final batch in batches) {
    final results = await Future.wait(batch.map(read));
    if (failed(results)) {
      for (final r in results) {
        await rollback(r);
      }
      throw StateError('failed');
    }
  }
}

// CASE early_exit_nested_loop expect=fire
Future<Object?> a2(List<Group> groups) async {
  for (final group in groups) {
    for (final item in group.items) {
      await save(item);
    }
    if (await done(group)) return group;
  }
  return null;
}

// CASE lazy_nested_loop expect=fire
Future<void> a3(List<List<int>> groups) async {
  Client? client;
  for (final group in groups) {
    client ??= await connect();
    for (final item in group) {
      await client.send(item);
    }
  }
}
